name: Nuns' Toast
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: piece of butter half the size of an egg
ingredients.originalText: a piece of butter half the size of an egg

instructions.text: Cut four or five hard-boiled eggs into slices
Put a piece of butter half the size of an egg into a saucepan
When it begins to bubble add a finely chopped onion
Let the onion cook a little without taking color
Stir in a teaspoonful of flour
Add a cupful of milk and stir until it becomes smooth
Put in the slices of eggs and let them get hot
Pour over neatly trimmed slices of hot buttered toast
Season the sauce to taste with pepper and salt

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut four or five hard-boiled eggs into slices
2. Put a piece of butter half the size of an egg into a saucepan
3. When it begins to bubble add a finely chopped onion
4. Let the onion cook a little without taking color
5. Stir in a teaspoonful of flour
6. Add a cupful of milk and stir until it becomes smooth
7. Put in the slices of eggs and let them get hot
8. Pour over neatly trimmed slices of hot buttered toast
9. Season the sauce to taste with pepper and salt
